This fix adds a `timeout` parameter to the SQLite connection when using a file-based database (not in-memory). The timeout tells SQLite how long to wait (in seconds) before giving up when trying to acquire a lock on the database. This prevents the "database is locked" error when multiple connections try to access the same persistent SQLite database file.
